issues.title: Format check overwrites tighter min/max already in the bag
issues.explanation: onattach hooks run in chain order on a shared bag. The range checks only narrow the bag, but this hook assigns the format's full range unconditionally, so z.bigint().min(0n).max(23n).check(z.int64()) reports minValue/maxValue (and JSON Schema bounds) as the whole int64 range although parsing still enforces 0..23. The result depends on chaining order. The same bug existed in $ZodCheckNumberFormat (.int() after .min()/.max()).
issues.fix: const curMin = bag.minimum ?? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; if (minimum > curMin) bag.minimum = minimum; const curMax = bag.maximum ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY; if (maximum < curMax) bag.maximum = maximum;
